title: Claude Inbox Zero
oneLineOutcome: My goal was to build a cheap AI email assistant based off of Inbox Zero. Created using Fable 5. TLDR: every run, it triages untriaged Gmail threads (To Reply, Awaiting, Newsletter, Marketing, Receipts, Notifications, Cold Email, FYI), labels them under an InboxZero/ namespace, and drafts replies in my voice for threads that need a response — it never sends; I review and hit send. It also learns my voice continuously from my sent mail, hunts the zombie subscriptions I never open, and ends each run with a digest of what needs me, what got filed, and what to unsubscribe from.
